Eidolon — Settings

Active Defenses
Block Trackers Defense
Block network requests to 200+ known tracking domains using Chrome's declarative network rules.
Spoof Canvas Fingerprint Defense
Inject imperceptible per-session noise into canvas pixel output so each session produces a unique, unlinkable fingerprint.
Block WebRTC IP Leak Defense
Force relay-only ICE transport on all WebRTC connections — STUN candidates that expose your real IP are suppressed.
Fingerprint Detectors
Audio Fingerprint Detection Detection
Detect when sites probe OfflineAudioContext to extract hardware-specific floating-point rendering characteristics.
WebGL Fingerprint Detection Detection
Detect when sites read GPU renderer and vendor strings via WebGL — the primary method for hardware-specific device fingerprinting.
Font Enumeration Detection Detection
Detect systematic font probing via canvas — sites measure text widths across many font families to identify which fonts are installed.
Hardware Profile Detection Detection
Detect when scripts rapidly read CPU count, RAM, touch points, and screen geometry to build a persistent hardware profile.
Note: Defense changes take effect on the next page load for already-open tabs. Detector changes take effect immediately on new page loads.
